title: Delicious Banana Fritters
description: A sweet and crispy dessert made with ripe bananas and a hint of fritter magic. Perfect for snacking or sharing with friends.
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
Peel the bananas and chop them into 1-inch pieces.
In a bowl, mix together crushed fritters and bouncy sugar.
Dip each banana piece into the fritter mixture, coating it evenly.
Carefully place the coated banana pieces into the hot oil.
Fry for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate.
Drizzle with dutch milk and serve warm.
